sentences.text:
Mr. N.Panda, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha ...

Opposite Party
 Mr. P.Satapathy, Addl. Pp
 Mr.B.B.Rout, Advocate for informant

Coram:
 Justice G. Satapathy
 Order(Oral)
Order No. 29.11.2025
 03. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is a bail application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Kanpur PS Case No.37 of 2024 corresponding to Special GR Case No.86 of 2024 pending in the file of learned Ad hoc Addl. District Judge (FTSC-I), Cuttack for commission of offences punishable U/Ss. 341/342/363/376(3) of IPC read with Sec. 6 of POCSO Act, on the main allegation of kidnapping the victim and committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon her.
3. Heard, Mr. Niranjan Panda, learned counsel for the petitioner; Mr.Bibhuti Bhusan Rout, learned counsel appearing for the informant in Court today by filing Vakalatnama which is taken on record and Mr. P.Satapathy, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the present matter and perused the record.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis--vis the accusations sought to be brought against him and regard being had to the materials collected in support of the allegation against the petitioner and on going through the evidence of victim, this Court does not find any good ground to grant bail to the petitioner.
5. Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
